Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UQS4F4JxwFSyyMxHhVdSYz

* fix(rounds): dedup recap decisions latest-wins so a revisit-after-ack never double-counts

The append-on-ack roundLog keeps a second entry for any item answered, flushed,
then changed via Back-as-revisit (goBack takes the setRevisit branch and the
original entry stays; submitDecision appends a new one). whatMoved counted every
MovedDecision raw, so one physical item rendered two contradictory outcome lines
("1 in your life" AND "1 resting for now"), inflated the total, and disagreed with
the idempotent answered cue.

Add dedupeDecisionsLatestWins (one row per (type,itemId), latest createdAt wins,
pairwise untouched) and apply it in the shared hook's recapDecisions builder so
both UsageRound and TriageRound benefit before whatMoved counts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01UQS4F4JxwFSyyMxHhVdSYz

* fix(rounds): synchronous demotion-guard ref + RecommendedRoundCard height reservation + RoundTimer boundary test

Fix A (final review #2): the usage timer-expiry demotion write gated on
newlyAnswered.size (React state), which lags the async submit. On the
localStorage-quota fallback the single-route POST is awaited across macrotasks;
a box expiring during that flush on the first answer ran the effect with
newlyAnswered.size===0 and demoted a device whose person actively answered. Add
a synchronous answeredThisRoundRef set inside handleUsage before the await and
gate expiry demotion on (queueExhausted || !answeredThisRoundRef.current).

Fix B (final review I1): reserve a min-height on RecommendedRoundCard so the
post-hydration primary→demoted swap never reflows the hub at narrow widths.

Fix C (final review T9): add a direct 60000ms boundary test pinning RoundTimer's
`remaining < 60_000` sub-minute cutoff (60000ms → minute form, 59999ms → sub).

The append-on-ack roundLog keeps a second entry for any item answered, flushed,
then changed via Back-as-revisit (goBack takes the setRevisit branch and the
original entry stays; submitDecision appends a new one). whatMoved counted every
MovedDecision raw, so one physical item rendered two contradictory outcome lines
("1 in your life" AND "1 resting for now"), inflated the total, and disagreed with
the idempotent answered cue.

pairwise untouched) and apply it in the shared hook's recapDecisions builder so
both UsageRound and TriageRound benefit before whatMoved counts.

Fix A (final review #2): the usage timer-expiry demotion write gated on
newlyAnswered.size (React state), which lags the async submit. On the
localStorage-quota fallback the single-route POST is awaited across macrotasks;
a box expiring during that flush on the first answer ran the effect with
newlyAnswered.size===0 and demoted a device whose person actively answered. Add
a synchronous answeredThisRoundRef set inside handleUsage before the await and
gate expiry demotion on (queueExhausted || !answeredThisRoundRef.current).

Fix B (final review I1): reserve a min-height on RecommendedRoundCard so the
post-hydration primary→demoted swap never reflows the hub at narrow widths.

Fix C (final review T9): add a direct 60000ms boundary test pinning RoundTimer's
`remaining < 60_000` sub-minute cutoff (60000ms → minute form, 59999ms → sub).
